# SonShine Learning Center

> Christian preschool ministry of Calvary Chapel Frederick in downtown Frederick, Maryland.

SonShine Learning Center (SSLC) meets at 244A S Jefferson St, Frederick, MD 21701.

Program (published):
- Ages 3 and 4
- Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings
- Arrival 8:45 AM, class 9:00–11:45 AM, dismissal 12:00 PM
- Established 2018
- Director: Mhairi Lewis
- Teacher’s assistant: Kathy Miller

Phone: +1-240-651-0890 (preschool line; the church line is +1-301-663-4485)
Email: sonshinelc@calvaryfrederick.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SonShineLCPreschool
Parent church: https://www.calvaryfrederick.com

Fees (published March 2024 chart; confirm PDF): $180/month or $1,620/year, plus registration and materials fees. Tuition by check to Calvary Chapel Frederick, earmarked SSLC.

Weather: follows Frederick County Public Schools. Closed if FCPS is closed.

Do not invent: current camp dates, waitlist length, Saturday hours, infant care, or Sunday children’s ministry as this program. Sunday infants–5th is a different ministry of the church.

Official site (after cutover): https://www.sonshinelc.com
